summary: FOCUSED frontend re-test (LIVE prod DB, SAFE MODE) of the member invite->accept->login->view->revoke flow on the preview URL. FIX #1 (accept CSRF) PASSES: POST /api/team/accept returned 200 in a real fresh browser context, no 'Couldn't accept the invite' error, the invitee was logged in and landed on /dashboard. FIX #2 (plus-addressed email) PASSES: /auth/login email step accepted dyno-rbac-retest+1788130464@example.com and advanced to the password step; sign-in succeeded. FIX #5 (revoke audited) PASSES: after revoking, the Activity panel shows BOTH 'Removed a team member' (just now) and 'Invited a team member' (4m ago). Nav gating regression PASSES: with company 1 selected the member sidebar has exactly 2 enabled items (dashboard, transactions) and 8 with data-denied='true' (payment-links, balances, invoices, customers, creator, wallets, settings, api), hover shows "You don't have permission for this", and clicking a denied item does NOT navigate. Company switcher shows 'The Dev Store | BUSINESS | MEMBER' via data-testid='company-role-1' with NO edit pencil for it. FIX #4 is PARTIAL: Transactions for the granted business correctly lists the owner's data ('Showing 1-10 of 661 transactions', real USDT/ETH/BTC rows), but the Dashboard volume KPIs are still the member's own zeros. FIX #3 FAILS: accepting the invite still auto-creates a personal company (company-option-98 'Dyno RBAC Retest' INDIVIDUAL) which becomes the DEFAULT workspace, and the onboarding wizard + 'You're in! Your first payment is platform-fee-free' modal auto-pop on first login. CLEANUP DONE: sentinel member revoked, team list shows 'No teammates yet', 0 team-remove buttons after reload.

minor.issue: Still NOT remapped to the company owner. Member saw 'This period $0 / 0 payments', a flat VOLUME-7DAYS chart and 'Monthly Volume $0/$10,000 · Starter 1.5%' while the OWNER for the same company_id=1 shows 'Monthly Volume $28,049.67/$100,000 · Growth 1%'. By contrast action-counts / recent-transactions / transactions list DID return the owner's data (PAYMENTS TODAY 3, ACTIVE WALLETS 13, real recent tx, 661 tx). All calls returned 200 (no server errors); only the effective-owner remap is missing in these 3 handlers.

ui_bugs.issue: Accepting a team invite STILL auto-creates a personal INDIVIDUAL company for the invitee (data-testid='company-option-98', named after the invitee, with an edit pencil) and that company is the DEFAULT selected workspace after login, so the member lands on their own blank onboarding dashboard instead of the granted business. Company switcher trigger read 'Dyno RBAC Retest', not 'The Dev Store'.

On the member's first login the 'You're in! Your first payment is platform-fee-free' modal auto-pops over the dashboard and the wizard rows 'Complete your account details / Add a payout wallet / Create your first payment link / Receive your first payment' plus the 'Make your first sale' empty state are shown to a pure invitee. Consequence of the auto-created company above.

Member-context chrome still merchant-onboarding flavoured: header chip 'Complete wallet setup' and the top banner 'Your first payment: 0% platform fee ... Start accepting payments' remain visible even with The Dev Store (an established business) selected.

Observed incidentally: with company 1 selected as OWNER, 'This period', PAYMENTS TODAY / ACTIVE WALLETS / TAX COLLECTED stayed as loading skeletons for >18s while backend logs show all /api/dashboard* calls returning 200 in <500ms (FX conversion for the display currency appears to block render). The member's equivalent cards rendered fine.

integration_issues.flow: invite -> accept -> member login -> view granted business
integration_issues.issue: Now works end-to-end (accept 200, plus-email login, member badge, gating, owner's transactions). Two residual gaps: default workspace is the auto-created personal company (member must switch manually) and the dashboard volume/fee-tier widgets show the member's zeros instead of the owner's figures.

issues: Zero 'This period' volume next to a real 'PAYMENTS TODAY 3 / ACTIVE WALLETS 13' and real recent transactions is internally contradictory to the user
Merchant onboarding banner + 'Complete wallet setup' chip shown to a view-only teammate

action_items: Do NOT auto-create a personal company on team-invite acceptance, and default the selected workspace to the granted (is_member) company so members land on The Dev Store with gating applied (FIX #3 still open).

Apply the same effective-owner remap used in dashboardController/getAllTransactions to the dashboard summary (GET /api/dashboard), /api/dashboard/chart and /api/dashboard/fee-tiers handlers so member volume/fee-tier KPIs match the owner (FIX #4 partially open).
Suppress the onboarding wizard, the 'first payment platform-fee-free' auto-modal, the 'Your first payment: 0% platform fee' banner and the 'Complete wallet setup' chip for member/invitee contexts.

DB cleanup (not possible from the UI): sentinel user_id=81 dyno-rbac-retest+1788130464@example.com and the auto-created company_id=98 'Dyno RBAC Retest' (INDIVIDUAL). Its team membership (team-remove-14) has been revoked, so it has no access to company 1.
critical_code_review_comments: The effective-owner resolution is being added per-controller; dashboard summary/chart/fee-tiers were missed. Centralise it (e.g. a resolveEffectiveOwner middleware bound to company_id) so every read route inherits it instead of ad-hoc reassignment.

Dashboard cache key is per-user ('[Dashboard] Cache hit for user 81') while the data is now company-scoped — key the cache by (effectiveOwnerId, companyId, currency) to avoid cross-company/cross-role cache bleed.

success_rate.frontend: 4.5 of 6 review items pass (~75%): FIX#1 PASS, FIX#2 PASS, FIX#3 FAIL, FIX#4 PARTIAL (transactions PASS / dashboard volume FAIL), nav gating PASS, FIX#5 PASS, cleanup PASS

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://setup-vault-5.preview.emergentagent.com . Selector gotchas: [data-testid='login-email-input'] and [data-testid='password-input'] ARE the <input> elements (fill them directly), but MUI TextFields in the team dialog need a nested input ([data-testid='team-invite-email'] input, [data-testid='team-invite-link'] input, [data-testid='accept-invite-name'] input, [data-testid='accept-invite-password'] input). Permission switches: [data-testid='team-perm-<key>'] input (click with force=True). accept-invite-submit appears twice - use .last. Revoke needs no confirm dialog. Settings sections are rail-driven ([data-testid='settings-rail-team']). Wait 8-10s after login/company switch; never wait for networkidle. Member gating only renders after selecting [data-testid='company-option-1'].
rca_of_the_issue: FIX#3: the invite-accept backend path still provisions a company for the new user; CompanyDataContext then picks that owned company as the default workspace (it sorts/first-wins on owned companies), so the invitee sees onboarding until manually switching. FIX#4 partial: only dashboardController's main data path and getAllTransactions were reassigned to the company owner; the summary/chart/fee-tier query builders still filter by req.user.id, returning the invitee's empty history ($0 volume, Starter tier) while action-counts/recent-transactions/transactions correctly return the owner's 661 transactions and 13 active wallets.
